create_youtu_config: create a YoutuConfig instance with custom model parameters for the Youtu-LLM-2B architecture
build_youtu_model: build a YoutuModel using a YoutuConfig for the encoder backbone of the model
run_youtu_causal_lm: run a YoutuForCausalLM model for autoregressive text generation with configurable parameters
initialize_youtu_weights: initialize YoutuPreTrainedModel weights using embedding_initializer_range and initializer_range
configure_youtu_attention: configure YoutuAttention layers inheriting from DeepseekV3Attention for the transformer blocks
